create_status_with_code_and_message: create an absl Status object with a StatusCode enum and error message string
manage_status_payloads: set, list, and erase binary payloads on an absl Status using SetPayload and AllPayloads
convert_status_code_int: convert between an integer and an absl StatusCode enum using StatusCodeFromInt and StatusCodeAsInt
raise_status_not_ok_exception: raise a StatusNotOk exception from a non-OK Status to assert failure in tests
build_canonical_error_status: build a canonical error Status like aborted_error or invalid_argument_error with a message
